sun.excels_at: Boosting Fire attacks and enabling sun-dependent abilities.
sun.watch_out_for: Opposing weather, Fire resists, and losing the weather setter.
benefits: Sets sun, which benefits this teammate's moves or ability.

rain.excels_at: Boosting Water attacks and enabling rain-dependent speed or accuracy.
rain.watch_out_for: Sun resets, Water immunities, and opposing speed control.
benefits: Sets rain, which benefits this teammate's moves or ability.

sand.excels_at: Enabling Sand Rush or Sand Force and applying weather chip.
sand.watch_out_for: Weather resets and chip damage to partners without immunity.
benefits: Sets sand, which activates this teammate's ability.

snow.excels_at: Supporting Ice attackers, accurate Blizzard, and Aurora Veil.
snow.watch_out_for: Weather resets and concentrated pressure on the weather setter.
benefits: Sets snow, which benefits this teammate's moves or ability.

trick_room.excels_at: Letting slow attackers move ahead of faster opposing teams.
trick_room.watch_out_for: Taunt, Imprison, opposing slow attackers, and exhausted room turns.
benefits: Sets Trick Room so this slow teammate can move ahead of faster opponents.

hard_trick_room.excels_at: Repeatedly establishing Trick Room for several slow attackers.
hard_trick_room.watch_out_for: Denied setup and limited attacking options outside Trick Room.
benefits: Sets Trick Room so this slow teammate can move ahead of faster opponents.

semiroom.excels_at: Choosing between a slow mode and a faster attacking mode.
semiroom.watch_out_for: Setting Trick Room at the wrong time for the partners on the field.
benefits: Sets Trick Room so this slow teammate can move ahead of faster opponents.

tailwind.excels_at: Giving attacking partners a temporary speed advantage.
tailwind.watch_out_for: Trick Room, speed drops, and opponents matching Tailwind.
benefits: Uses Tailwind to give this attacker a temporary Speed boost.

hyper_offense.excels_at: Applying immediate damage pressure with several fast attackers.
hyper_offense.watch_out_for: Limited defensive switching and losing control of move order.

bulky_offense.excels_at: Trading hits while maintaining attacking pressure.
bulky_offense.watch_out_for: Repeated chip and opponents setting up against passive turns.

balance.excels_at: Combining attackers, supporting partners, and speed control.
balance.watch_out_for: Specialized engines that overwhelm the available defensive answers.

defensive.excels_at: Reducing damage and preserving partners through longer exchanges.
defensive.watch_out_for: Taunt, strong setup attackers, and overwhelming double targets.

stall.excels_at: Winning prolonged exchanges through recovery and residual damage.
stall.watch_out_for: Doubles damage output, Taunt, and opponents that ignore passive damage.

setup.excels_at: Creating protected turns for a boosted attacker to become a win condition.
setup.watch_out_for: Haze, Clear Smog, Encore, and being attacked before boosting.
benefits: Provides support that can create a turn for this teammate to set up.

screens.excels_at: Reducing incoming damage to create setup or positioning turns.
screens.watch_out_for: Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, critical hits, and screen expiration.

perish_trap.excels_at: Threatening a countdown knockout while restricting switching.
perish_trap.watch_out_for: Ghost-type escape, pivot moves, and losing the trapper too early.
benefits: Can restrict opposing switches during this teammate's Perish Song countdown.

commander.watch_out_for: Haze, Clear Smog, Unaware, and playing with one active attacker.
benefits: Activates Commander alongside Dondozo to raise its stats.

psyspam.excels_at: Enabling terrain-boosted Psychic attacks and grounded priority protection.
psyspam.watch_out_for: Dark types, terrain replacement, and Wide Guard against spread moves.
benefits: Sets Psychic Terrain to power up this teammate's grounded Psychic attacks.

electric_terrain.excels_at: Supporting Electric damage and Quark Drive activation.
electric_terrain.watch_out_for: Ground types and terrain replacement; grounded sleep is also blocked.
benefits: Sets Electric Terrain to support this teammate's Electric attacks or Quark Drive.

gravity.excels_at: Improving move accuracy and removing Ground immunities from airborne targets.
gravity.watch_out_for: Short field duration and exposing allied airborne Pokemon to Ground attacks.
benefits: Uses Gravity to improve this teammate's accuracy or ground airborne targets.

quirky.excels_at: Combining unusual partner interactions to create a distinct win condition.
quirky.watch_out_for: The specific engine being disrupted; novelty alone is not competitive strength.

tailroom.excels_at: Switch between Tailwind for fast attackers and Trick Room for slow attackers.
tailroom.watch_out_for: Both modes need field turns. Tailwind can make your own attackers move later while Trick Room is active.
benefits: Sets Trick Room so this slow teammate can move ahead of faster opponents.
Uses Tailwind to give this attacker a temporary Speed boost.

sunroom.excels_at: Set sun and Trick Room so a slow attacker can use sun-boosted damage.
sunroom.watch_out_for: Opposing weather, denied Trick Room, and losing tempo while setting up both conditions.
benefits: Sets sun, which benefits this teammate's moves or ability.
Sets Trick Room so this slow teammate can move ahead of faster opponents.

rainroom.excels_at: Use Trick Room to give slow rain-powered attackers favorable move order.
rainroom.watch_out_for: Sun can remove the damage boost. Swift Swim can work against a slow mode while rain is active.
benefits: Sets rain, which benefits this teammate's moves or ability.
Sets Trick Room so this slow teammate can move ahead of faster opponents.

pivot_control.excels_at: Cycle switching moves and damage control to bring attackers into favorable positions.
pivot_control.watch_out_for: Trapping, strong spread damage, Defiant or Competitive, and repeated chip on pivots.

redirection_setup.excels_at: Use Follow Me or Rage Powder to buy a setup turn for an offensive partner.
redirection_setup.watch_out_for: Spread moves bypass redirection. Grass types, Overcoat, and Safety Goggles can ignore Rage Powder.
benefits: Can draw eligible single-target attacks away while this teammate sets up.

priority_offense.excels_at: Pressure weakened opponents with multiple damaging priority users and back them up with direct offense.
priority_offense.watch_out_for: Psychic Terrain and priority-blocking abilities can stop attacks. Some priority moves require the target to attack.

physical_ruin.excels_at: Use Sword of Ruin to amplify an allied physical attack, including priority or Body Press.
physical_ruin.watch_out_for: Sword of Ruin also lowers allied Defense. Psychic Terrain and priority blockers can blunt priority variants.
benefits: Lowers other Pokemon's Defense with Sword of Ruin, increasing this ally's physical damage.

special_ruin.excels_at: Use Beads of Ruin to amplify allied special spread damage.
special_ruin.watch_out_for: Beads of Ruin also lowers allied Special Defense, and Wide Guard can stop spread damage.
benefits: Lowers other Pokemon's Special Defense with Beads of Ruin, increasing this ally's special spread damage.

grassy_terrain.excels_at: Use Grassy Terrain for grounded Grass damage, Grassy Glide priority, and passive recovery.
grassy_terrain.watch_out_for: Terrain replacement, Grass resists, and reduced damage from Earthquake against grounded targets.
benefits: Sets Grassy Terrain to power up eligible Grass attacks from this grounded teammate.

coaching.excels_at: Use Coaching to raise an ally's Attack and Defense so it can deal damage and take physical hits.
coaching.watch_out_for: Taunt, Haze, and strong special damage can disrupt the plan. Coaching needs the attacker alongside its user.
benefits: Uses Coaching to raise this teammate's Attack and Defense.

beat_up.excels_at: Target an ally with Beat Up to charge Rage Fist or trigger Justified repeatedly.
beat_up.watch_out_for: The opener can be stopped by Fake Out or disrupted by redirection. Fainted and statused team members reduce the number of hits.
benefits: Can target this teammate with Beat Up to charge Rage Fist or activate Justified.

commander_costar.excels_at: Put a Perish Song countdown on Tatsugiri before Commander so Flamigo can enter and copy Dondozo's boosts after Tatsugiri faints.
commander_costar.watch_out_for: The handoff takes multiple turns. Dondozo must stay in and retain its boosts for Costar to copy.
benefits: Activates Commander alongside Dondozo to raise its stats.
Can pass its current stat stages to this Costar teammate once it can enter beside Dondozo.

dancer.excels_at: Pair Dancer with an ally that uses dance moves so Oricorio can copy them.
dancer.watch_out_for: Disruption before the dance and concentrated damage on Oricorio make the pair hard to sustain.
benefits: Uses a dance move this teammate can copy through Dancer.

gravity_sleep.excels_at: Use Gravity to improve the accuracy of sleep moves such as Hypnosis.
gravity_sleep.watch_out_for: Gravity expires quickly and grounds both sides. Electric or Misty Terrain can protect grounded targets from sleep.
benefits: Uses Gravity to improve the accuracy of this teammate's sleep move.

pao_nite.excels_at: Use Chien-Pao's Sword of Ruin alongside Dragonite's Extreme Speed for immediate priority damage.
pao_nite.watch_out_for: Ghost types are immune to Extreme Speed. Priority blockers and Psychic Terrain can stop it against protected targets.
benefits: Lowers other Pokemon's Defense with Sword of Ruin, increasing Dragonite's Extreme Speed damage.

blizzard_spam.excels_at: Set snow and pressure both opposing slots with multiple Blizzard users.
blizzard_spam.watch_out_for: Wide Guard blocks Blizzard, and weather replacement removes its snow accuracy benefit.
benefits: Sets snow so this teammate's Blizzard bypasses the normal accuracy check.

aurora_veil.excels_at: Set snow and use Aurora Veil to help a teammate withstand hits while setting up.
aurora_veil.watch_out_for: Weather replacement can prevent Veil from going up. Critical hits can bypass its protection.
benefits: Sets the snow required to use this teammate's Aurora Veil.
Uses Aurora Veil in snow to reduce incoming damage while this teammate sets up.
